segments.text:
V. 24.
No prophet is acceptable in his own country—That is, in his own Neighbourhood. It generally holds, that a Teacher ſent from GOD, is not ſo acceptable to his Neighbours, as he is to Strangers. The Meanneſs of his Family, or Lowneſs of his Circumſtances, bring his Office into Contempt: Nor can they ſuffer that he, who was before equal with or below themſelves, ſhould now bear a ſuperior Character.
